title: a fourth tool language must fail closed, not guess
titleZh: 第四种工具语言必须 fail-closed,而不是猜
why: The collector cannot know every Windows tool language. When nothing matches, the only honest answer is unknown with the raw text attached for a human (defensive-spec 3.2 L5 / 4.2 rule 3). A guess here would be a security-relevant false verdict.
inject: netsh section headers and the whole powercfg structure replaced with unmatched spellings (no hex indices, no pattern hit)
expectSummary: NIC_PROFILE_ATTRIBUTION unknown/nic_unparsed with raw preserved, POWER_STANDBY_IDLE_AC_DC unknown/power_unparsed, exit != 0
